name: commons-coins-endgame-cards-v1
description: ⭐ THE COMMONS WITH COINS, THE ENDGAME CARDS STILL PRICED IN CARDS (Dean, 10/09/2026). It is overlays/commons-coins-v1.overlay.json EXACTLY, every one of its seven passengers pinned to the same value, WITH ONE CHANGE: rules.economy.endgameCoinCost is null, so the fifteen Endgame cards keep their v31 cost of two cards of their own suit and the coin has ONE SINK left instead of two - the Farmstead. THE QUESTION IT ANSWERS is what K15 is worth, and it has two halves. (1) THE ECONOMY: with one sink rather than two, do coins pile up dead? If coins held at game end jump here against the arm, K15 is carrying real weight; if they do not, the Farmstead alone was already soaking up the mint and the Endgame price is buying a design argument rather than a balance one. (2) THE MONOCULTURE PULL, which is the design argument: ⛔ K15 IS THE ONLY ONE OF THE TWO PULLS THAT LEAVES, because K13 moves the Farmstead's own-crop scorer to the BARN rather than deleting it. So this pairing is the clean read on the own-crop build share, last measured at 82.6% before v31 and 83.3% after and never re-read since: the arm should sit a little BELOW this overlay, and a large gap either way means the coin economy moved it rather than the price. ⚠️ Read Endgame cards built per player and by suit beside the share, and read winning scores and their sources beside both, since an Endgame card that is cheaper to reach is points as well as a pull. ⛔ NOTHING ELSE MOVES. Its sweep partner is overlays/commons-coins-endgame-price.sweep.json, which prices the card at 2, 3 and 4 instead of switching it off. UNRUN BEFORE THIS PASS.
